coverage: 2000-present numbered EO archive; disaster proclamations from 2023 on from the Governor's listing, plus proclamations added by hand: 2006-2011 (Blagojevich, Quinn) from the Governor's releases, Illinois delegation releases and dated news coverage, 2013-2022 (Quinn, Rauner, Pritzker) from IEMA news releases and news coverage, and the August 2024 proclamation from IEMA-OHS; other pre-2023 proclamations are not listed. Proclamations signed weeks after the storm they declare are compared on the storm's first day. Federal declarations since 2000 with no state record yet: EM-3161, DR-1368, DR-1416, DR-1469, DR-1513, EM-3199, DR-1747, EM-3283, DR-1771
